Barrick Gold Corp (ABX) Holder Ruffer Llp Boosted Its Position Posted by Nellie Frank 1:00 pm
Ruffer Llp increased its stake in Barrick Gold Corp (ABX) by 399.8% based on its latest 2018Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Ruffer Llp bought 14.01M shares as the company’s stock rose 41.80% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 17.51M shares of the precious metals company at the end of 2018Q3, valued at $194.12 million, up from 3.50 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Ruffer Llp who had been investing in Barrick Gold Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $15.97B market cap company. The stock increased 0.07% or $0.01 during the last trading session, reaching $13.65. About 13.40 million shares traded. Barrick Gold Corporation (NYSE:ABX) has risen 1.32% since December 27, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 1.32% the S&P500.
Ruffer Llp, which manages about $3.02B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 76,159 shares to 166,042 shares, valued at $37.49M in 2018Q3, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Foot Locker Inc (NYSE:FL) by 1.21M shares in the quarter, leaving it with 277,247 shares, and cut its stake in Mckesson Corp (NYSE:MCK).
